pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The concentration is the story. Western Railway, the major client, accounts for 52% of the orders on hand, and Indian Railways as a whole brought in 57% of total revenue in the year ended 31 March 2018.[^drhp-p65][^drhp-p67]
pull_quotes.quote: Indian Railways contributed 57% of the company's revenue in the year ended 31 March 2018, and Western Railway alone accounts for 52% of the orders on hand.
pull_quotes.rationale: This single disclosed fact frames the entire risk profile; it is the sharpest number in the filing.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue comprises 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a price to be determined.[^drhp-p29] The rupee size and price-to-face-value multiple are not disclosed in the extract.[^drhp-p55] The stated objects are working capital of ₹1,130.00 lakhs (₹11.30 crore) and general corporate purposes (amount redacted).[^drhp-p48] Lead manager: Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited; registrar: Bigshare Services Private Limited.[^drhp-p31]
sidebars.rationale: A compact sidebar gives the reader the essential offer details without breaking the narrative flow.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The restated financial statements in the DRHP are printed in lakhs; this report converts to crore by dividing by 100. The revenue picture is a decline in three of the past five years: ₹86.61 crore in FY2014, ₹90.21 crore in FY2015, ₹74.53 crore in FY2016, ₹73.44 crore in FY2017, and ₹60.53 crore in FY2018.[^drhp-p27] That is roughly a 33% fall from the FY2015 peak to the FY2018 trough.
tables.footnote: Source: DRHP restated statements, pages 26, 27 and 111.[^drhp-p26][^drhp-p27][^drhp-p111]
tables.rationale: The five-year trend of revenue decline and the FY2018 profit spike are the core financial story; a table lets the reader see the pattern at a glance.
tables.title: Five-year restated financials (₹ crore)
